Four British men convicted of sex crimes against drugged woman

Four British men were convicted on Thursday of raping or sexually abusing a woman who had been drugged by her husband. The case has been compared to that of Gisele Pelicot, a French woman who became a symbol in the fight against sexual violence. Two men were found guilty of rape, and two others of sexual assault. One report mentioned the husband had advertised the woman.
